items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: when I was with Cootie's band, we had a show composed of the Ink Spots, Ella Fitzgerald, Eddie Vinson, Ralph Brown, dancers.

ctx.x: I don't know. We came into the Savoy, and... No, we had been out with the Ink Spots. We had worked, oh, six months or more with the Ink Spots, and Ella Fitzgerald... We had a big show. Had a big show. It was quite a show. We played 27 theatres from New York to California. We played 27 theatres, and broke records at 26 theatres.. Broke records. I mean, in Chicago...
